main_text.p: ibidem deprehendi , ut à petendis iis magiftratibus , in quorum adminiftra-tione falus aut periculum totiús populi vertitur , fponte fuá abftineat , eofque illis , qui plurimum poflunt, relinquat, contenta vero iis fit, eofque affectet, qui mercedem fecum trahunt, & rei familiari quæftum aliquem afferunt. Ad rem nunc redeo. Præter ea , quæ dicta jam funt,conftat,cognoviffe quo-que fenatum hunc caufas τ̀ ἀδυνάτων, qui ob inopiam ftipe è publico juva-ri fe petebant , de criminibus etiam εἰσαγγελίας nonnullis ad fe delatis, fi magnam pœnam mererinon videren-tur, judicium fuum interpofuiffe, cæte-roqui ad δικαςηρίῳ majora, quorum[illegible, ~6 letters] hæc propria cognitio fuit , remififfe, ærarii quoque debitores , cum pofceret res, feverius ad folutionem compuliffe,[illegible, ~4 letters] deniq; extruendarum inftruendarum-que quotannis novarum triremium[illegible, ~6 letters] curam commendatam habuiffe. Ut igitur integrior hic fenatus effet , tan-tam rerū molem in civitate fuftinens,[illegible, ~4 letters] ac in omnibus reipublicæ negociis po-[illegible, ~4 letters]pulo præfens , ad corrigendam fortis temeritatem à legislatore fcitum olim fuit , ut fi quos forte fors promovifler, qui honore indigni viderentur, jus effet ipfi

page.notes: The right margin is partly covered by a red-pink band, so the marginal notes are mostly unreadable and are marked as illegible with approximate lengths. The Greek words δικαςηρίῳ and εἰσαγγελίας are uncertain in their final letters. The catchword "ipfi" is taken from the foot of the page. The right edge is a dark red scan border and is not transcribed.
